title: RAW UNREVIEWED: Cato resumes a named plant list as all these kinds, then selects a procedural subset with quae
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED_NO_MEANING_CLAIM. Complete cached Cato133 names plant kinds, resumes them collectively with haec omnia genera and a propagation/removal obligation, then begins Quae diligentius seri voles to select what is wanted for more careful planting. This preserves collective type-topic scope and the restricted class of procedural patients instead of turning a topic nominal into an event or treating every named kind as one physical batch.

design.mechanism: A written enumeration is resumed by a demonstrative universal class nominal before a predicate. A later relative construction restricts the patients for a more careful pot-planting branch. Thus class-topic assertion, selected procedural patients and subsequent concrete branch/basket arguments have different types and quantifier scopes.
design.unit: Complete Cato De Agri Cultura133 sections1–4, Latin Hooper/Ash1934 witness retained in cached source-only dossier.
design.contrast: Named members -> all-these-kinds topic -> propagation predicate, then relative-selected more-careful planting patients versus a topic nominal already denoting an executed action, an unlicensed latest-only object, or every enumerated kind undergoing every later branch.
design.prediction: A future source-inspired whole construction must separately consume the class-topic nominal with its collective predicate and give the relative-selected patient subset an explicit downstream procedural role. Preserve all versus selected scope without representing type names as completed operations or one coidentical physical lot. If a nominal contributes only a topic label, the construction still owes a written predicate and patient binding; English coherence alone does not pay either. No current wordform meaning or target is nominated.
design.scope: Local historical nominal/resumptive construction raw duty, not a universal topic-marker translation or a new Cato encoder. GDT1001 two-serializer capacity failure,425layering route and942list-total result remain unchanged.

source_evidence.quote: Propagatio pomorum ceterarumque arborum. Arboribus abs terra pulli qui nati erunt, eos in terram deprimito, extollito, uti radicem capere possint. Inde, ubi tempus erit, effodito seritoque recte. Ficum, oleam, malum Punicum, mala strutea, cotonea aliaque mala omnia, laurum Cypriam, Delphicam, prunum, murtum coniugulum et murtum album et nigrum, nuces Abellanas, Praenestinas, platanum, haec omnia genera a capitibus propagari eximique ad hunc modum oportebit. Quae diligentius seri voles, in calicibus seri oportet. In arboribus radices uti capiant, calicem pertusum sumito tibi aut quasillum; per eum ramulum trasserito; eum quasillum terra inpleto calcatoque, in arbore relinquito. Ubi bimum erit, ramum tenerum infra praecidito, cum quasillo serito. Eo modo quod vis genus arborum facere poteris uti radices bene habeant. Item vitem in quasillum propagato terraque bene operito, anno post praecidito, cum qualo serito.

The source construction provides a topic-to-predicate duty but no evidence selecting OL, qOL or any current wordform as its exponent.
